blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla has expressed confidence that the plunder case of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez can be completed in a year as he emphasized that there will not be delaying tactics in resting their cases. Last September, the Ombudsman filed a plunder case against Romualdez and two other co-accused before the Sandiganbayan over alleged kickbacks worth at least P7.44 billion. Romualdez is currently detained at the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology Jail Male Dormitory in Quezon City. “Within a one year period, pwedeng tapusin namin ang case namin.
